title: Client Project Folder Generator v2.0.3 Official Release
changelog: • Dynamic Root Folders: Multiple Root Folders dropdown history & instant 1-click switching.
• Context Menu Auto-Root: Right-click inside any folder in Windows Explorer to auto-set it as the Root folder.
• Active Explorer Detection: Tools menu shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+O) to automatically grab active Windows folder.
• Custom Template Isolation, Clean Success Dialog, and Auto-Close on Finish.
